sources.summary: Standalone desktop incense toy; manual rituals any time, not dependent on development tools
Visual-only. No repository access, deployment mutation, credentials, network services or AI runtime
Incense lighting, burning smoke, wish text, local persistence and show/hide
AI implements, tests and repairs; select stack by product and executable verification, not familiarity
Use Agent Continuity v0.3.4; preserve sources/checks/evidence, fail closed, fresh review
Execution mode; phase by phase; coherent commits instead of tiny changes
Desktop transparency, click-through recovery, tray, drag and low-resource rendering are separate native checks
Windows-first MVP; other platforms and deployment/harness plugins are later extensions
A second same-tick save can be stranded after the synchronous browser adapter drains but before running is cleared. Preserve last-write-wins with a serialized writer and regression tests.
Expanded window sizing must fit the current monitor and compact mode needs a real drag handle; recovery must remain usable after display changes.
Visibility events must clear an already scheduled wall-clock tick; reduced motion must still update incense length without continuous smoke animation.
Tray Quit must flush the newest frontend snapshot before native exit; a failed save must not silently close the app.
